description: heretek-context-router production base config (Wave 3): loads ONLY the lazy meta-tool broker plus context-mode so the upfront MCP schema footprint stays under 500 tokens. All domain backends (n2-qln, ghidra-mcp, adb-maestro, godot, research) stay behind the lazy broker and the :3000 agentgateway.

heretek-lazy-broker.description: Lazy meta-tool router exposing ONLY mcp_search_tools, mcp_inspect_schema, mcp_call_tool (<400 tokens)

context-mode.description: 4-layer invariant prompt prefix assembler (KV-cache stable frozen prefix)

lazyBackends.note: These backends are NOT loaded into context. They are discovered lazily via mcp_search_tools and routed via mcp_call_tool through the agentgateway on :3000.
